refresh_token.description:
JWT refresh token for obtaining new authentication tokens.

This token was previously issued during login or a previous refresh operation. It is validated against the todo_app_member_sessions table to verify the session exists, has not expired, and belongs to an active member account.

The token must be a valid JWT string. Invalid or expired tokens result in 401 unauthorized response. Upon successful validation, the system generates a new access and refresh token pair.

Used to query session table, verify session exists and is not expired (expired_at > now), verify belongs to active member (deleted_at is null). ITodoAppMember.IRefresh.description:

Contains the refresh token that was previously issued during login or a previous refresh operation. The token is validated against the todo_app_member_sessions table to verify the session exists, is not expired, and belongs to an active member account.

Upon successful validation, the system generates new access and refresh tokens and updates the session record. Invalid or expired tokens return 401 unauthorized.

All other DB properties excluded: session metadata (ip, href, referrer) captured at login, timestamps system-managed, actor identity resolved from JWT validation.

ITodoAppMember.IAuthorized.description:
Authentication response containing member identification and JWT tokens after successful login, registration, or token refresh.

This DTO is returned by the /todoApp/auth/member/join, /todoApp/auth/member/login, and /todoApp/auth/member/refresh operations. It provides the authenticated member's core identity information (id, email, display_name) along with audit timestamps (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and a token object containing JWT credentials for subsequent API authentication.

The token object contains short-lived access tokens and long-lived refresh tokens, enabling secure stateless authentication. Members use the access token in the Authorization header for all authenticated requests.

This DTO supports partial updates - only include the fields you want to modify. Omitted fields retain their current values. The title field must be non-empty if provided. Description, start date, and due date can be set to null to explicitly clear them.

JWT refresh token for obtaining new access credentials.

A long-lived token that was issued during guest registration or a previous refresh operation. This token is exchanged for a new access token and refresh token pair.

The token must be valid, unexpired, and correspond to an active session in the database. Invalid or expired tokens result in authentication failure with a 401 response.

Request body for refreshing guest authentication tokens.

Contains the refresh token to exchange for new credentials and session context information for audit purposes. The refresh token must be valid and unexpired.

filter.description:
Filter todos by completion status.

Controls which todos are included in the result set based on their completion state. The 'all' option returns both complete and incomplete todos. The 'complete' option returns only todos marked as finished. The 'incomplete' option returns only todos that are still pending.

When not provided or null, defaults to 'all' showing all todos regardless of completion status.

sort.description:
Sort field for ordering the todo list.

Determines which attribute is used to sort the results. The 'creation_date' option orders by when todos were created. The 'start_date' option orders by the planned start date. The 'due_date' option orders by the deadline.

When not provided or null, defaults to 'creation_date'. When sorting by start_date or due_date, todos without the respective date appear at the end of the list regardless of sort direction.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Sort field enum: 'creation_date' (created_at column), 'start_date' (start_date column), 'due_date' (due_date column). Nullable - when null or undefined, defaults to 'creation_date'. For start_date and due_date, null values are placed at end using COALESCE.

sortDirection.description:
Sort direction for ordering the todo list.

Controls whether results are ordered in ascending or descending order. 'ASC' returns results from oldest/earliest to newest/latest. 'DESC' returns results from newest/latest to oldest/earliest.

When not provided or null, defaults to 'DESC' for creation_date sorting (newest first) and 'ASC' for start_date and due_date sorting (earliest first).

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering starts from 1, so the first page is page 1 (not 0). This enables navigation through large result sets by requesting one page at a time.

When not provided, defaults to page 1. Must be at least 1 - values less than 1 are invalid.

Maximum number of records per page.

Controls how many todo items are returned in a single response. This enables clients to manage response size and implement efficient pagination. The actual number of records returned may be less than this value on the final page or when total records are fewer than the limit.

When not provided, defaults to 20. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive - values outside this range are invalid.

ITodoAppTodo.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving a filtered and sorted list of todos with pagination support.

This DTO defines the query criteria for listing todos owned by the authenticated member. The filter parameter controls which todos are returned based on completion status. The sort parameter determines the ordering field, while sortDirection controls ascending or descending order. Pagination is handled through page and limit parameters.

The filter supports three modes: 'all' returns both complete and incomplete todos, 'complete' returns only finished todos, and 'incomplete' returns only pending todos. When sorting by start_date or due_date, todos without the respective date appear at the end of the list regardless of sort direction.

Member identity resolved from JWT, not from request body.

ITodoAppTodo.description:
Complete todo entity representing a task with all its attributes and relations.

This is the main response type for todo operations, containing the full todo record including title, optional description and dates, completion and deletion status, audit timestamps, the owning member, and all edit history entries.

The {@link member} property provides the todo owner's summary information via BELONGS-TO relation. The {@link editHistories} array contains all historical edits made to this todo as a HAS-MANY composition. Nullable fields ({@link description}, {@link startDate}, {@link dueDate}, {@link deletedAt}) use oneOf to represent null values when not set.

Nullable fields (description, start_date, due_date, deleted_at) use oneOf with null. Member relation uses $ref to ITodoAppMember.ISummary.

IETodoAppTodoSort.description:
Sort field enumeration for ordering todo list results.

This enum defines the available fields for sorting todo lists. The 'creation_date' option orders todos by when they were created. The 'start_date' option orders by the planned start date, with todos lacking a start date appearing at the end. The 'due_date' option orders by the deadline, with todos lacking a due date appearing at the end.

This type is used in conjunction with {@link IESortDirection} to control the complete sort behavior of todo list queries.

IESortDirection.description:
Sort direction enumeration for controlling the order of paginated list results.

This type defines the two possible sort directions: 'ASC' for ascending order (oldest to newest, earliest to latest) and 'DESC' for descending order (newest to oldest, latest to earliest). Used in list request parameters to specify how results should be ordered.

When used in nullable contexts, the default value is determined by the specific endpoint and sort field. For example, creation date sorting typically defaults to DESC (newest first), while start date and due date sorting typically default to ASC (earliest first).

Two possible values: 'ASC' (ascending order, oldest/earliest to newest/latest) and 'DESC' (descending order, newest/latest to oldest/earliest). Used in list request DTOs to control ORDER BY direction. When nullable in request DTOs, null defaults to endpoint-specific default (e.g., DESC for creation_date, ASC for date fields).

IETodoAppTodoFilter.description:
Filter options for retrieving todos based on completion status.

This enum defines three filtering modes for todo list queries. The 'all' option returns both complete and incomplete todos without any completion status filter. The 'complete' option returns only todos that have been marked as finished. The 'incomplete' option returns only todos that are still pending and not yet completed.

When 'all' is selected or when the filter parameter is null/undefined, the query returns all todos regardless of their completion state. This is useful for viewing the complete todo list. The 'complete' and 'incomplete' filters enable focused views on finished or pending tasks respectively.
